title: Pokemon TCG Sylveon Holo & Reverse Holo Lot 040/131, One of Each
descriptionText: This product is a lot of two Pokemon trading cards featuring Sylveon in both holo and reverse holo versions, from the Prizmatic set. Manufactured by Nintendo in 2025, these cards are part of the Pokemon franchise and TV show. As a collector's item, this lot offers a unique opportunity to own one of each card of this popular character, making it a valuable addition to any trading card collection.
